description: Diverse triage set: 50 IDH-wildtype GBM (TCGA-GBM), 50 IDH-mutant LGG (TCGA-LGG), 50 other primary CNS (CCDI-MCI), 50 non-CNS / metastasis (the real brain metastases in IDC, then TCGA lung, breast, melanoma, kidney and colorectal primaries), 50 normal brain (GTEx). FFPE, and PAXgene for GTEx. Random (seeded) slides of 100 MB to 2 GB, one per patient.
